observations: The actual northeast street elevation has a red-brown square-tiled lower storey, warm grey upper walls, two tall turquoise-tiled glazed stair strips and small square vents below the flat eave.

Two upper rectangular window bands and the lower row are irregularly spaced around the glass stairs and opaque service-wall areas. Original approximate artwork retains these material/role differences instead of copying a residential facade.
The referenced school/service frontage differs from the nearby taller Sturenkatu8 elevation. No photographed pixels, logos, graffiti, vehicles or people are reproduced.
limitations: Only the complete declared native northeast source plane is painted; courtyards, other wings, roof service bodies and small returns retain their native finish until individually qualified.
Window/stair spacing and colours are approximate reference-led interpretation, not measured facade dimensions. Small mechanical fixtures are simplified.
Native triangle coordinates, indices, winding and collision remain unchanged.

The native source plane continues beyond the delivered northern street extent. Nine actual native visual/HCOL pairs qualify only its exact in-bounds outward baseline interval. Artwork on the background remainder uses the same roof-relative architectural datum; no outside floor, access, ground alignment or playable continuation is claimed.
